Prospex 1965 Diver's Modern Re-interpretation

Dive · 40–40.5mm · 200m, later increased to 300m · automatic · 2020–2023

The Prospex 1965 Diver's Modern Re-interpretation is a family of dive watches that pays homage to Seiko's and Japan's first diver's watch, the 62MAS from 1965. This line is defined by its blend of vintage-inspired design cues from the original 62MAS with contemporary technology and specifications.

The story

The family originates from the iconic 1965 Seiko 62MAS, the brand's first professional dive watch. In 2020, Seiko introduced the first modern re-interpretations, including the SPB143 and the limited edition SPB149, which captured the spirit of the original with a more contemporary build and the 6R35 caliber. This initial series was produced until 2024 and was praised for its versatile 40.5mm case size and 200m of water resistance. A new generation was launched in June 2024 with references like the SPB451 and SPB453, featuring a slightly smaller 40mm case, increased water resistance to 300m, and the newer 6R55 caliber with a longer power reserve.
